body:
The `India` calendar models NSE clearing holidays, but it treats six 2024–2025 holidays as business days. Two were added mid-year after the annual list was published, and four are in the annual list itself:

| Date | Holiday | Source |
|---|---|---|
| 18 Sep 2024 | Id-E-Milad, moved from 16 Sep by Maharashtra; both were settlement holidays | NCL/CMPT/63950, NCL/CMPT/63955 |
| 20 Nov 2024 | Maharashtra Assembly elections (trading holiday) | NSE circular of 8 Nov 2024 |
| 1 Apr 2025 | Annual Bank Closing | NCL/CMPT/65916 |
| 27 Aug 2025 | Ganesh Chaturthi | NCL/CMPT/65916 |
| 8 Sep 2025 | Id-E-Milad, moved; declared a trading and settlement holiday in addition to 5 Sep | NCL/CMPT/70039 |
| 21 Oct 2025 | Diwali Laxmi Pujan | NCL/CMPT/65916 |

The Ramzan Id and Id-E-Milad dates for 2024–2025 are no longer estimates, so the corresponding comments and the note in the header are updated.

**Tests:** `testIndia` now checks the complete 2025 holiday list against NSE Clearing circular NCL/CMPT/65916 plus the 8 Sep addition, and the two 2024 additions. It fails on master on exactly these six dates and passes with this change.
